description:
Music to Unwind | Surbahar Instrumental | 3 Hours of Evening Calm

After a long day, the body wants to rest — but the mind keeps replaying, planning, and scrolling.

This peaceful Indian ambient meditation music is designed to help you put the day down: slow racing thoughts, release built-up tension, and ease your evening into deep, calm rest.

Enjoy 3 hours of deep, resonant surbahar melodies blended with warm tanpura drone, soft ambient textures, and long spacious pauses designed for unhurried evening listening.

Perfect for unwinding after work, evening relaxation, stress relief, reading, dinner ambience, meditation, mindfulness, gentle yoga, journaling, and peaceful nights at home.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Surbahar (bass sitar) & Tanpura Drone
Raga: Raga Yaman — the classic evening raga
Style: Indian ambient meditation / slow evening instrumental
Mood: Calm, deep, warm, spacious, grounding
Atmosphere: Evening unwind, after-work decompression, quiet rest
Duration: 3 Hours

🎧 HOW TO USE
Press play in the early evening — after work, over dinner, while reading, or in the last quiet hour before your night routine. Keep the volume low and let the deep surbahar tones slow everything down. For the most immersive experience, use headphones or listen in a quiet room.
